title: ComfyUI
idiom: pen-and-ink diagram with woodcut weight — technical node-graph rendered as hand-drawn schematic, dark ink on cream, no CGI
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop in deep indigo and warm amber: a hand-drawn node-graph schematic fills the frame, rendered in heavy woodcut-style black ink lines on aged cream — interconnected rectangular nodes joined by flowing curved edges, each node holding a simple abstract glyph (sampler, checkpoint, VAE, clip) rather than any text. At the center a latent cloud dissolves into a forest-pond image emerging from a final node, amber firefly-light bleeding into indigo water. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial. Two figures — one woman, one man — lean over the graph from opposite sides, their hands tracing edges. Medium: pen-and-ink diagram with woodcut weight.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem, high contrast black on cream: a single heavy-ink node-graph symbol — three rectangular nodes connected by two thick curved arrows forming a simple chain, the rightmost node emitting a small radiating burst glyph. Survives at 24px. No fine linework, no text, no letters, no numerals — purely diagrammatic mark.
